headline: Venezuelan Unions Call 12-Hour National Strike Over Bonuses
summary: Unions in Venezuela called a 12-hour national strike for November 16 as workers demand $960 year-end bonuses folded into regular salaries.
why: Labor strikes disrupt commercial activities and reflect underlying macroeconomic pressures and public sector wage disputes.

impacts.name: Venezuela
impacts.why: National strikes temporarily reduce operational output across public and administrative sectors.
